subject: QBR pack: mosaic review + approval timeline

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kelly Jones <kelly.jones@boardsec.org>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@benchmarkcap.com>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR pack: mosaic review + approval timeline

Team —

Attached is the working deck (QBR_Mosaic_v0.3.pptx) and the operational metrics workbook. This is the consolidated mosaic for the investor/board packet; it pulls together leadership highlights, OKR temperature checks, and a short appendix on cost/latency trends (Redwood Dedicated).

High-level asks:
- Please review slides 3–12 (strategy + OKR heatmap) for factual accuracy and OKR status updates by EOD Friday (2028-05-10).
- Ben: confirm the SLA numbers on slide 9 and swap in the 99.9% figure if the handoff is complete.
- Marissa: add a one-paragraph customer story for slide 6 (Benchmark progress).
- Tessa: please run a final styling pass (fonts, logos, investor-friendly bullets).

Timeline:
- 5/10 EOD: content freeze from leadership (comments only).
- 5/11 morning: legal + finance redline pass.
- 5/11 afternoon: final deck assembly and sign-off.
- 5/12 10:00 PT: circulate PDF to board + investors.

Notes: Priya Shah (Benchmark) will want the two-slide appendix on commercial KPIs — Priya, I copied you for visibility; you should get the appendix by Friday and we’ll ensure sensitive metrics are gated.

I built the deck to be modular: if we need to shorten, we can collapse slides 11–14 (appendix).

Thanks — Vivek

--

Vivek — thanks for the draft. Quick notes after a first pass:
- Slide 6: will add Benchmark customer quote and a one-paragraph ROI summary (taking from our May 2 email thread with Priya).
- Slide 4 (OKR heatmap): I suggest we add a short sentence on measurement cadence so it’s clear this is mid-quarter status, not final.
- I’ll add a small chart to appendix A showing ARR expansion cadence for Benchmark.

Uploading my content now (attached as Board_Summary_notes.docx). I’ll ping again when slide copy is in.

Vivek / Laura —

Confirmed: the SLA callout on slide 9 should read 99.95% for dedicated instances, not 99.9%. I’ll attach an excerpt from our SRE runbook for reference (Operational_Metrics_May.xlsx).

Also: on slide 10 where we show latency trends, please add a note on the June L4 kernel rollout as a planned headwind mitigation. Small comment, but useful for investors to see the forward plan.

Ben

Vivek / Marissa —

Appreciate the preview. Two quick asks from our side:
1) The commercial appendix needs ARR retention numbers for the last four quarters (you can redact customer-level identifiers if needed).
2) Can you include a one-line note on data residency for enterprise deals (we’re tracking customers in EU who asked about Private deployments).

If it helps, Tom Reed from Acme Ops is looping our internal board reviewer into the packet circulation. We prefer the final PDF by 5/12 morning if possible.

Thanks — Priya

- Ran accessibility checks; all contrast ratios pass.

- Content freeze met (all leadership comments captured).
- Finance redlines are minor (numbers footnoted) — Priyom, please confirm the footnote language and I’ll sign off.
- Legal cleared text for customer examples with the redaction we agreed.

Vivek: I approve the final deck to be circulated to board and investors Monday morning. Priya / Kelly, you should expect the PDF via DocuSign envelope (for acknowledgment) at 10:00 PT on 2028-05-12.

If any last-minute, material change appears, escalate to me directly. Great work.
